🔍 Database vs. Data Warehouse vs. Data Lake – What's the Difference?

When it comes to data storage, knowing the right tool for the job is everything. Here's a quick breakdown to help you navigate the landscape:

💾 Database
 → Stores real-time, transactional data (think customer orders, app activity)
 → Best suited for day-to-day operations (OLTP)
 → Examples: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle

📊 Data Warehouse
 → Stores structured, cleaned data ready for reporting and analytics
 → Ideal for business intelligence and historical trends (OLAP)
 → Examples: Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery

🌊 Data Lake
 → Stores raw data—structured and unstructured
 → Great for AI/ML workloads and exploratory analysis
 → Examples: AWS S3, Azure Data Lake, Hadoop HDFS
